blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine men’s baseball team cruised past regional rival Thailand, 18-7, after seven innings in the placement round of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 at Okazaki Chuo Sogo Park Baseball Stadium. John Vargas had four RBIs while Mark Steven Manaig and Jimbo Matanguihan drove in three runners apiece as the Philippines prevailed over the team it beat for the gold in last year’s Southeast Asian Games.
